title: UneceCargo
description: Information about goods being transported identifying their nature for customs, statistical or transport purposes.

cargoCategoryTypeCode.description: The code, such as UNECE Recommendation 21 single digit codes, specifying the type of transported cargo.

cargoCommodityCategoryStatisticalClassif.description: The code specifying a statistical classification for this transport cargo.

cargoOperationalCategoryCode.description: The code specifying the operational category for this transport cargo, such as obnoxious or military.

identification.description:
Identification, expressed as text, of this transport cargo that is sufficient to identify it for customs, statistical or
transport purposes.
